tools.name: find_sunny_destinations
tools.description: Ranked answer to "where is it sunny (and warm) in <month>?" — destinations sorted by that month's 0–100 Sunshine Score (long-term climate normals). tools.name: get_destination_climate
tools.description: Full climate card for one destination: 0–100 Sunshine Score, day/night °C, rainfall, midday UV index (WHO scale) and sea temperature for all 12 months, plus its sunniest month ("best time to visit" for sunshine), annual sunshine hours and peak midday UV. Accepts a city name ("Faro"), "city, country"

tools.name: compare_destinations
tools.description: Side-by-side sunshine/climate comparison of 2–5 destinations — overall or for one month ("Algarve or Crete in October?"). Returns each place's Sunshine Score, temperatures, rain, midday UV index and sea temperature, plus a one-line verdict of which is sunnier.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_sunny_destinations" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
